# Wrapbook

> > Wrapbook is a production payroll and accounting platform for film, television, and commercial productions, offering employer of record services, labor compliance tools, and financial management resources.

Wrapbook serves production companies with payroll processing, tax incentive management, and production accounting solutions. The platform provides educational content on film financing, union compliance (including IATSE Local 600), and production workflows for independent films, commercials, and unscripted content.

## Key Topics

- Production Payroll
- Production Accounting
- Film Financing
- Labor Compliance
- Employer of Record (EOR)
- Gap Financing
- Independent Film
- Tax Credits and Incentives
- Commercial Production
- Union Classifications
- Fraud Prevention
- Cash Flow Management
- Unscripted Production
- Film Distribution
- Production Budgeting

## Production Payroll & Accounting

- [Resources for Production Payroll](https://www.wrapbook.com/top-production-payroll-resources): Free production payroll resources for filmmakers and crew onboarding
- [Breaking Down EOR Payroll for Production Companies](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/breaking-down-employer-of-record-payroll-for-production-companies): How production companies benefit from employer of record payroll services
- [What to Know About Commercial Accounting](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/know-about-commercial-accounting): Production accounting basics and concepts for film production finance
- [Keep Your Productions Fraud-Free](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/keep-your-productions-fraud-free): Fraud prevention strategies for production payroll and AI-driven scams
- [Accounting for the Reality of Unscripted](https://www.wrapbook.com/events/accounting-for-the-reality-of-unscripted): Webinar with Margot Ransom on unscripted production cost management

## Film Financing & Budgeting

- [Essential Guide: Film Financing](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/film-financing-essential-guide): Comprehensive guide to film financing sources and funding strategies
- [How to Secure Gap Financing for Your Project](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/gap-financing-film): Expert panel from IFTA on securing gap financing for film projects
- [AFM in Review: Maximizing Your Budget with Location Choices](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/afm-in-review-maximizing-your-budget-with-location-choices): AFM panel on film tax credits and budget optimization through locations
- [Resources for Feature Film Producers](https://www.wrapbook.com/top-resources-for-feature-film-producers): Feature film production resources: permits, payroll, budgeting templates

## Production Resources & Guides

- [Agency Producers & How to Work with Them](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/agency-producer): Guide to agency producers in commercial production and ad agencies
- [How to Work with Fight Coordinators](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/fight-coordinator): Guide to collaborating with fight coordinators on action filmmaking
- [Film Commissions with Katie Pryor](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/katie-pryor-film-commission): Katie Pryor on film commission services and production incentives
- [7 Best Photo Studios in Los Angeles](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/best-photo-studios-los-angeles): Top LA photo studios from budget-friendly to luxury production spaces
- [Best Practices for Researching and Selling a True Crime Series](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/how-to-research-and-sell-a-true-crime-series): Jeff Turner of 44 Blue Productions on pitching true crime to networks
